title: China’s2018–2021 ASF shock and poultry comparison
before_food: Pork within China’s existing animal-food market
after_food: Pork contraction with concurrent poultry expansion; later pork rebound
event_period: August2018 onward; primary comparison2018–2019; household extension2018–2021
baseline_exposure: 2018 already includes ASF outbreak months; not a clean untreated pre-period

production.unit: million tons as published by NBS
production.geography: China excluding Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR and Taiwan Province

household.measure: NBS household purchases/consumption excluding away-from-home meals, as reproduced by ERS
household.value_2021_discrepancy: NBS's own 2021 per-capita pork figure is widely reported as 25.2 kg; its 2022 figure (26.9 kg, up 6.75%) implies 25.2. ERS value 25.8 retained as transcribed pending a check of ERR-326 Table 4 against the NBS yearbook.
household.source_table_note_discrepancy: Table4 saysFigure11; neighboringFigure10 supplies the national series. Originalyearbooktable not independently retrieved.

drivers.account: ASF-related pig losses and disruption; poultry was an existing alternative species.
Movement restrictions, disease zoning and controls documented byFAO; their separate effects on household substitution are not identified.

speed.observation_window: One calendar-year production comparison; two-year household change and subsequent one-year reversal

elasticity.reason: ERS qualitative inelasticity is not a fitted own/cross-price elasticity. Ma2021 inverse-demand policy model is a lead; full coefficients and methods remain unreviewed.

transport_to_cultivated_chicken.relevance: Existing substitute capacity and relative prices can matter after a conventional livestock supply shock; test capacity, affordability and persistence separately.
cautions: Conventional poultry production is not cultivated-chicken adoption.
China’s pork-centred market and disease shock do not establish Muslim-country halal or market-access conditions.
Rebound and COVID-era survey composition weaken claims of permanent diet conversion.

unresolved: Original NBS yearbook householdtable and full survey design not independently retrieved.
Hao full methods, coefficients and parallel-trend evidence remain unreviewed.
Ma2021 full inverse-demand estimates and model assumptions not acquired;2020conference lead failed.
